description: This Java class 'DelinquencyWritePlatformServiceHelper' provides helper methods for managing loan delinquency status, including applying delinquency based on overdue days, setting delinquency tags, sorting delinquency ranges, and handling installment-level delinquency details. It interacts with repositories, notifies business events, and manages delinquency range classifications within the Fineract financial platform.

classes.name: DelinquencyWritePlatformServiceHelper
classes.description: A helper service class that manages delinquency tagging and classification for loans and loan installments within the Fineract platform, interacting with repositories and firing events.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyForLoan
methods.description: Determines the appropriate delinquency range for a loan based on overdue days and applies the corresponding delinquency tag.

methods.name: setLoanDelinquencyTag
methods.description: Updates the loan's delinquency tag, setting it to a specified range or clearing it, and manages historical records and event notifications.

methods.name: sortDelinquencyRangesByMinAge
methods.description: Sorts a list of delinquency ranges by their minimum overdue days in ascending order.

methods.name: applyDelinquencyForLoanInstallments
methods.description: Applies delinquency classification at the installment level for a loan based on each installment's overdue days.

methods.name: removeDelinquencyTagsForNonExistingInstallments
methods.description: Deletes delinquency tags linked to installments that no longer exist.

methods.name: setDelinquencyDetailsForInstallment
methods.description: Assigns delinquency range tags to individual loan installments based on overdue days.

methods.name: getInstallmentDelinquencyRange
methods.description: Finds the appropriate delinquency range for an installment given its overdue days.

methods.name: setDelinquencyDetailsForInstallment
methods.description: Creates, updates or deletes delinquency tags for a specific loan installment based on its overdue days and the classification ranges.
